title: KIDS Act
excerpt: The proposal will require online services to be safe by design and defines 15 as the age to create autonomous social media accounts.
content_html:
The proposal will require online services to be safe by design and defines 15 as the age to create autonomous social media accounts.

The EU KIDS Act is built around four pillars that enhance the EU’s protection of children online and minimise these risks. These pillars are:

  1. A social media delay
  2. Safety by design principles
  3. Age assurance and parental responsibility
  4. Strong enforcement

The Act will complement existing rules to protect children online.
